skill.descTemplate: 使用声骸技能，幻形为寒霜陆龟，持续{0}秒。每秒对周围造成共计{1}冷凝伤害，自身获得5层【坚硬】和{3}的移动速度提升，每层【坚硬】使受到的伤害降低{2}，每次受到伤害减少一层【坚硬】（每秒至多触发一次）。幻形期间，每次击中敌人，附近队伍中所有角色获得{4}的攻击力（每秒至多触发一次），至多叠加{5}层，持续{6}秒，当受到伤害使得【坚硬】层数归零时，失去攻击力加成，并提前结束幻形状态。技能冷却：{7}秒

skill.descEnRank5: Transform into Hoartoise for 20s, dealing up to 283.20% Glacio DMG to surrounding enemies each second and gaining 5 stacks of "Hardening." Each stack of "Hardening" reduces incoming DMG by 20.00% and increases Movement Speed by 15.00%. Lose a stack of "Hardening" when hit (up to one stack per second). Attacks during transformation increase nearby party members' ATK by 12.50% on hit (up to one stack per second), stackable for up to 8 times, lasting for 20s. Losing all stacks of "Hardening" will remove all the ATK boosts and end the transformation. Cooldown: 40s.
